---
name: demo-script
description: Prepare a reproducible 60-second VenturaVision demo that proves one implemented vision capability and its limitation. Use when an executable MVP slice needs a concise demonstration. Do not use when the feature is not implemented or the demo would rely on unversioned manual steps.
---

# Demo script

- Choose one implemented capability and one versioned or licensed sample.
- Show the input expected command or API call and resulting output.
- Keep setup outside the 60-second core demonstration.
- Include one visible limitation or failure case when practical.
- Avoid claims that exceed measured behavior.
- Make every command copyable from a clean checkout.
- Verify the demo from the documented environment before publishing it.
